Deformation in all cases was governed by slip-dominated mechanisms, with the specific slip systems activated varying with orientation and strain rate.
EBSD characterization of shear band formation in the [111] orientation under dynamic compression

The combination of high strain rate sensitivity, strong cryogenic strengthening, and slip-dominated plasticity suggests that this alloy is well-suited for applications requiring both high strength and ductility under cryogenic loading conditions.
